required_script_behavior: Treat stale pid/hwnd from prior packets as evidence only; re-enumerate current windows at runtime.
Sample foreground window 3 times before any focus action using GetForegroundWindow, GetWindowThreadProcessId, process name, and title.
If any foreground sample is LockApp, LogonUI, Windows Default Lock Screen, or inaccessible interactive desktop, stop as BLOCKED_LOCKAPP_PRE_ACTION without clicking or capturing Claude UI.
Enumerate monitors using System.Windows.Forms.Screen.AllScreens and record bounds/working area.

Enumerate Claude candidates using EnumWindows, IsWindowVisible, GetWindowText, GetWindowRect, DwmGetWindowAttribute extended frame bounds if available, GetWindowThreadProcessId, Get-Process, and process path if accessible.
Filter candidates to visible top-level process claude windows with safe generic Claude title, not minimized, width >= 600, height >= 400, and not LockApp/LogonUI/shell/desktop.
Select candidate with largest visible intersection with primary monitor working area.
If needed, restore/place selected Claude window inside primary DISPLAY2 working area using ShowWindowAsync and SetWindowPos with safe margins; no mouse click.
Activate using ShowWindowAsync, BringWindowToTop, AttachThreadInput for the activation attempt, SetForegroundWindow, and optionally WScript.Shell.AppActivate only after exact candidate selection.
If foreground becomes LockApp/LogonUI, stop as BLOCKED_LOCKAPP_AFTER_ACTIVATION.
If foreground is not selected Claude, stop as BLOCKED_FOREGROUND_NOT_CLAUDE.
Only after foreground is confirmed as Claude, run read-only UI Automation discovery and privacy-safe crop capture.
Never save raw full-window screenshots; keep full capture in memory only if needed to compute redacted crops.
Stop before typing, paste, Enter, Send, submit, Run, credential entry, or any model-backed response.
